cohort_filter: ICD I48.* (atrial fibrillation and flutter) on hospital admissions
description: 13 structured csv files (7 top-level + 4 icu + 2 multimodal/ecg). Split key is SUBJECT_ID (not hadm_id): train/val/test are fully disjoint at subject / hadm / stay / study granularity, so ref ⊆ raw for ECG multimodal. cohort.csv has one row per hadm, so it is sliced by hadm_id via hadm→subject mapping. scorer grades all 13 via equal_file_row_aligned_v1. summary.json is metadata only and is intentionally NOT copied into reference/ (the harness walks reference/ recursively and would fail load_evaluation_manifest's key_columns check on summary.json). multimodal/notes.csv is not included because I48 source has no discharge notes.

cohort.csv.notes: cohort table; one row per hadm_id in the I48 cohort; hadm_id is the unique row key. Derived from admissions + ICD filter on diagnoses_icd. Sliced by hadm_id via hadm→subject→split mapping (subject-level split ⇒ hadm partition follows).

demographics.csv.notes: subject-keyed (one row per subject). Routed by the owning subject_id (subject-level split ⇒ one row per split, no cross-split duplicates).

medications.csv.notes: all 8 columns used as a composite key; raw may contain ~6 dup rows after compression

icu/icustays.csv.notes: one row per ICU stay; hadm_id-anchored, but the unique row key is stay_id

icu/chartevents.csv.notes: all 7 columns used as a composite key; raw may contain ~70 dup rows after compression

multimodal/ecg_manifest.csv.notes: ECG study manifest; one row per ECG study. has hadm_id + subject_id + waveform_path (GPU_10T external path; hea_exists/dat_exists are metadata flags, NOT filesystem checks). Routed by subject_id (subject-level split ⇒ study_id ⊆ split's subject partition ⇒ ref ⊆ raw).

multimodal/ecg_measurements.csv.notes: ECG measurements + 18 free-text report fields (report_0..report_17) + 11 numerical measurements (rr_interval, p_onset, p_end, qrs_onset, qrs_end, t_end, p_axis, qrs_axis, t_axis, bandwidth, filtering, cart_id). Score via row-keyed alignment only on study_id; report fields and measurement columns are scored as-is.

_auxiliary_files._comment: summary.json is intentionally NOT in 'files'. scorer would error trying to extract columns from a JSON document, and load_evaluation_manifest would raise 'missing key configuration: summary.json'. summary.json stays in the source split tree (e.g. /Users/mac/Downloads/归档/I48_atrial_fibrillation_ECG_3000/summary.json) but is NOT copied into the reference/ tree used by the harness.

summary.json.expected_role: kept in source; not part of scoring

absent_files._comment: Files NOT present in I48 source that might be expected in other MIMIC-IV tasks.
absent_files.multimodal/notes.csv: I48 source has no discharge notes; this file is omitted from 'files' to avoid 'manifest references unknown gold files'.
